evals.name: alert-lookup
evals.prompt: I just got paged for PersistenceLatencySevereFiveMinutes on s-cd059. What should I check?
evals.expected_output: Specific triage steps for this alert including root causes, commands to run, dashboards to check, and when to escalate

assertions.text: Response references the specific alert name PersistenceLatencySevereFiveMinutes
Lists at least 2 concrete root causes (e.g., Astra node degradation, gocql heartbeat failures, large payload cache bypass, DB connectivity)
Provides at least 1 specific CLI command or dashboard URL for triage
States when to escalate vs when to watch for self-resolution

evals.name: resourceexhausted-symptom
evals.prompt: We're seeing ResourceExhausted errors on a single namespace. Is this likely customer-side or platform-side?
evals.expected_output: Distinction between customer-side vs platform-side indicators, relevant checks to determine which, and appropriate next steps

assertions.text: Explicitly addresses both customer-side and platform-side possibilities
Notes that single namespace affected is a customer-side indicator
Suggests checking rate limits (frontend.globalNamespaceRPS or APS/RPS limits)
References Chronicle or fine-grained per-second metrics for verification

evals.name: auto-resolution-stats
evals.prompt: Which alerts have the highest auto-resolution rate? I want to know which pages I can probably just watch.
evals.expected_output: List of alerts with high auto-resolution rates sourced from alert-stats.json, with specific percentages

assertions.text: Includes specific auto-resolution percentages (not just qualitative high/low)
Lists at least 3 specific alert names with their auto-resolution rates
The auto-resolution rates cited are accurate per alert-stats.json data

evals.name: cell-url-error
evals.prompt: I'm going to https://cloud.temporal.io/support/cells/s-saa-cogs but it says 'ERROR'D! ConnectError: [invalid_argument] unknown cell s-saa-cogs'. What is the right URL?
evals.expected_output: Explanation that s-saa-cogs is not a valid cell name, examples of real cell name formats (s-cd0XX, s-gc0XX, s-aw0XX, etc.), and how to find the correct cell name

assertions.text: Explains that s-saa-cogs is not a valid cell name
Provides examples of real cell name formats (s-cd0XX, s-gc0XX, s-aw0XX, etc.)
Suggests a concrete way to find the correct cell name (e.g., omni command, listing cells, or checking dashboards)
